newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE TO START DEFENCE OF EUROPEAN CUP AT HOME.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE TO START DEFENCE OF EUROPEAN CUP AT HOME.

text.p: Holders Brive were on Wednesday
drawn against Scottish Borders in the first game of their
European Cup defence in September.
The French club, who beat England's Leicester in last
season's final, were drawn in pool C with Welsh champions
Pontypridd, English first division runners-up Bath and the
Scottish Borders.
Twenty clubs are split into five groups of four, with each
team playing their group opponents home and away.
The five pool winners automatically qualify for the
quarter-finals, with the remaining three places being decided in
play-off matches on November 1 and 2 featuring the five pool
runners-up and the best third-placed team.
Pool A - Leinster (Ireland), Toulouse (France), Leicester
(England), Milan (Italy)
Pool B - Swansea (Wales), Wasps (England), Ulster (Northern
Ireland), Glasgow (Scotland)
Pool C - Brive (France), Bath (England), Scottish Borders
(Scotland), Pontypridd (Wales)
Pool D - Munster (Ireland), Harlequins (England), Bourgoin
(France), Welsh representative.
Pool E - Paul (France), Caledonia (Scotland), Treviso
(Italy), Welsh representative.
